hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; [[ "$f" == *.rs ]] && crate=$(basename $(dirname $(dirname "$f"))) && cargo clippy -p "$crate" 2>&1 | head -40 || true'
bash -c '[[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == */Cargo.lock ]] && echo "BLOCK: Cargo.lock chỉ sửa qua cargo, không edit trực tiếp" && exit 1 || true'
